data.one_liner: Dart library for accessing SDL3 and related APIs via FFI.
data.what_it_does: Provides FFI bindings to SDL3 and its extension libraries (SDL3_image, SDL3_mixer, SDL3_net, SDL3_ttf, SDL3_gfx, SDL3_shadercross) for Dart applications. It enables cross-platform handling of windows, graphics, audio, input devices, and game logic.
use_when: You are building a game or multimedia application in Dart that requires low-level control over rendering and hardware.
You want to use SDL3 features and optional extension libraries through FFI on 64-bit desktop or mobile platforms.
avoid_when: You need support for 32-bit systems (the library is limited to 64bit).
You are building standard cross-platform UI apps using Flutter's built-in widget tree and framework.
strengths: Comprehensive coverage of SDL3 structures and functions.
Includes support for SDL3 extensions like image, mixer, net, ttf, and shadercross.
Modern immutable design patterns with Arena memory management.
weaknesses: Requires manual provisioning of native shared libraries (.dll, .so, or .dylib) depending on the target OS.
data.setup_notes: Requires ensuring native 64-bit dynamic libraries for SDL3 and any optional modules (SDL3_image, SDL3_mixer, etc.) are available in the runtime environment for Windows, Linux, Android, or macOS.
